src/dataset.c

This file creates and loads the experiment’s answer key. Expected outcomes are assigned by the dataset author, not by whichever scorer ranks first.

Use a fixed generator and validate every appended label

Section titled “Use a fixed generator and validate every appended label”

The xorshift32 sequence makes seed-42 mutations reproducible across C libraries; standard rand does not specify that sequence. append checks field capacities, duplicate inputs and target membership. A generated typo that becomes a different canonical name is refused. Copies occur only after those checks.

Download complete source
1/** @file2 * [PM-Da9sE2] Labels are the answer key; the algorithms do not create them.3 * Generation is explicit. Benchmark runs load frozen CSVs and validate them.4 * A family belongs to only one split: related typos must not leak into calibration.5 */6#include <ctype.h>7#include <errno.h>8#include <stdlib.h>9#include <string.h>10#include "pm.h"11const char *category_names[CATEGORIES] = {12    "exact",13    "formatting",14    "deletion",15    "insertion",16    "substitution",17    "transposition",18    "multiple_errors",19    "punctuation_boundary",20    "partial",21    "reordered_semantic",22    "near_collision",23    "unknown",24    "ambiguous",25    "length_boundary"26};27static uint32_t random_state;28/** Fixed xorshift32 moves the seed through the same sequence on every run. */29static uint32_t next_random(void) {30    uint32_t x = random_state;31    x ^= x << 13;32    x ^= x >> 17;33    x ^= x << 5;34    random_state = x;35    return x;36}37/** Map a stored label to the same bucket used in the report; -1 means invalid metadata. */38int category_index(const char *s) {39    int i;40    for (i = 0; i < CATEGORIES; ++i) if (!strcmp(s, category_names[i])) return i;41    return - 1;42}43/** Find a target by its authoritative name, never by fuzzy similarity. */44static int target_index(const Registry *r, const char *target) {45    size_t i;46    for (i = 0; i < r->n; ++i) if (!strcmp(r->p[i].name, target)) return (int) i;47    return - 1;48}49/** [PM-La4bV7] Admit a labeled case only after checking its identity and intent.50 * A generated typo must not become another real property. Duplicate rows are refused. */51static int append(Dataset *d, const char *prefix, const char *schema, int category, const char *input, const char *target,52    Expected expected, const char *family) {53    size_t i;54    TestCase *c;55    Registry *r = registry_get(schema);56    char norm[KEY_MAX + 1];57    int valid = normalize(input, norm, sizeof norm);58    int case_fits = d->n < MAX_CASES && strlen(input) <= KEY_MAX;59    int valid_category = category >= 0 && category < CATEGORIES;60    int metadata_fits = strlen(schema) < sizeof d->cases[0].schema &&61                        strlen(target) < sizeof d->cases[0].target &&62                        strlen(family) < sizeof d->cases[0].family;63    if (!case_fits || !valid_category || !metadata_fits || !r) return 0;64    for (i = 0; i < d->n; ++i) if (!strcmp(d->cases[i].schema, schema) && !strcmp(d->cases[i].input, input)) return 0;65    if (expected == EXPECT_RESOLVED && target_index(r, target) < 0) return 0;66    if (valid && !r->collision) {67        for (i = 0; i < r->n; ++i) {68            int exact_canonical_name = !strcmp(norm, r->p[i].normalized);69            int inconsistent_label = expected != EXPECT_RESOLVED || strcmp(target, r->p[i].name);70            if (exact_canonical_name && inconsistent_label) return 0;71        }72    }73    c = &d->cases[d->n];74    memset(c, 0, sizeof *c);75    (void) snprintf(c->id, sizeof c->id, "%s%04zu", prefix, d->n + 1);76    /* Capacities were checked above; include the terminator in each copy. */77    memcpy(c->schema, schema, strlen(schema) + 1);78    memcpy(c->category, category_names[category], strlen(category_names[category]) + 1);79    memcpy(c->input, input, strlen(input) + 1);80    memcpy(c->target, target, strlen(target) + 1);81    memcpy(c->family, family, strlen(family) + 1);82    c->expected = expected;83    ++d->n;84    return 1;85}

Create formatting variants and character mutations

Section titled “Create formatting variants and character mutations”

Standard toupper and tolower generate casing variants. mutate uses memmove when insertion or deletion shifts overlapping suffix bytes. An inserted byte shifts the terminator too. A transposition of equal adjacent letters is skipped because it would not create a distinct case.

86/** Create formatting variants from PascalCase without changing their intended target. */87static void spaced(const char *s, char *out, char separator, int upper) {88    size_t i, k = 0;89    for (i = 0; s[i] && k < KEY_MAX; ++i) {90        unsigned char c = (unsigned char) s[i];91        int word_start = i && isupper(c) && islower((unsigned char)s[i - 1]);92        if (word_start && k < KEY_MAX) out[k++] = separator;93        if (k >= KEY_MAX) break;94        out[k++] = (char)(upper ? toupper(c) : tolower(c));95    }96    out[k] = '\0';97}98/** [PM-Mu8zN3] kind 0=delete, 1=insert, 2=replace, 3=swap, 4=two replacements.99 * Deletion shifts the suffix left; insertion shifts it right, including the terminator.100 * Repeated-letter swaps are skipped because they would not change the spelling. */101static int mutate(const char *s, char *out, int kind) {102    size_t n = strlen(s), pos = (size_t) (next_random() % (uint32_t) n);103    char ch = (char) ('a' + next_random() % 26U);104    if (n > KEY_MAX) return 0;105    memcpy(out, s, n + 1); /* Every caller provides KEY_MAX+1 bytes. */106    /* Suffix source/destination overlap: use memmove, not memcpy.107     * Deleting from "cat" at pos=1 copies "t" AND its '\0' over "at". */108    if (kind == 0) memmove(out + pos, out + pos + 1, n - pos);109    else if (kind == 1) {110        if (n >= KEY_MAX) return 0;111        memmove(out + pos + 1, out + pos, n - pos + 1);112        out[pos] = ch;113    } else if (kind == 2) {114        if (out[pos] == ch) return 0;115        out[pos] = ch;116    } else if (kind == 3) {117        char t;118        if (pos + 1 >= n || out[pos] == out[pos + 1]) return 0;119        t = out[pos];120        out[pos] = out[pos + 1];121        out[pos + 1] = t;122    } else {123        size_t p2 = (pos + n / 2) % n;124        out[pos] = ch;125        out[p2] = (char) ('a' + next_random() % 26U);126    }127    return strcmp(s, out) != 0;128}129/** Retry rejected mutations until the requested distinct-case count is filled, with a finite attempt cap. */130static int generated(Dataset *d, const char *prefix, const char *schema, int category, size_t count, int kind) {131    Registry *r = registry_get(schema);132    size_t added = 0, tries = 0;133    char input[KEY_MAX + 1], family[64];134    while (added < count && tries++< 100000) {135        size_t p = (size_t) (next_random() % (uint32_t) r->n);136        if (!mutate(r->p[p].normalized, input, kind)) continue;137        (void) snprintf(family, sizeof family, "%s-%zu-mut%d", schema, p, kind);138        if (append(d, prefix, schema, category, input, r->p[p].name, EXPECT_RESOLVED, family)) ++added;139    }140    return added == count;141}142/** Write the simple seven-column manifest; generated fields contain no commas/newlines. */143static int save(const char *path, const Dataset *d, uint32_t seed) {144    FILE *f = fopen(path, "w");145    size_t i;146    if (!f) return 0;147    fprintf(f, "# dataset=%s;seed=%u;split=%s\n", DATA_VERSION, (unsigned) seed, path);148    fputs("id,schema,category,input,expected,target,family\n", f);149    for (i = 0; i < d->n; ++i) {150        const TestCase *c = &d->cases[i];151        fprintf(f, "%s,%s,%s,%s,%d,%s,%s\n", c->id, c->schema, c->category, c->input, (int) c->expected, c->target, c->family);152    }153    return fclose(f) == 0;154}

Load a strict seven-field CSV subset without losing empty fields

Section titled “Load a strict seven-field CSV subset without losing empty fields”

fgets reads bounded rows; strchr separates commas in place and strcspn removes line endings. Empty target fields matter for unknown inputs, so strtok would be unsuitable even without the ban. Capacities and the numeric label are validated before memcpy. Quoted CSV input is intentionally outside this manifest format.

340/** [PM-Lo2dJ5] Read a strict CSV subset into bounded fields.341 * Split commas in-place, check every capacity, then copy. Do not truncate labels. */342int load_dataset(const char *path, Dataset *d) {343    FILE *f = fopen(path, "r");344    char line[2048];345    size_t row = 0;346    if (!f) return 0;347    d->n = 0;348    while (fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) {349        char *fields[7], *p = line;350        size_t k;351        TestCase *c;352        long outcome;353        ++row;354        if (line[0] == '#' || !strncmp(line, "id,", 3)) continue;355        if (!strchr(line, '\n') || d->n >= MAX_CASES) {356            fclose(f);357            return 0;358        }359        line[strcspn(line, "\r\n")] = '\0';360        fields[0] = p;361        for (k = 1; k < 7; ++k) {362            p = strchr(p, ',');363            if (!p) break;364            /* Replace the comma with a terminator, then move p to the next field.365             * fields[] points into line; no field buffers are allocated here. */366            *p++ = '\0';367            fields[k] = p;368        }369        if (k != 7 || strchr(fields[6], ',')) {370            fprintf(stderr, "invalid manifest row %zu\n", row);371            fclose(f);372            return 0;373        }374        c = &d->cases[d->n];375        memset(c, 0, sizeof *c);376        int field_too_long = strlen(fields[0]) >= sizeof c->id || strlen(fields[1]) >= sizeof c->schema || strlen(fields[2]) >= sizeof c->category ||377        strlen(fields[3]) > KEY_MAX || strlen(fields[5]) > KEY_MAX || strlen(fields[6]) >= sizeof c->family;378        if (field_too_long) {379            fclose(f);380            return 0;381        } {382            char *end;383            errno = 0;384            outcome = strtol(fields[4], &end, 10);385            if (errno || end == fields[4] || *end || outcome < 0 || outcome > 3) {386                fclose(f);387                return 0;388            }389        }390        memcpy(c->id, fields[0], strlen(fields[0]) + 1);391        memcpy(c->schema, fields[1], strlen(fields[1]) + 1);392        memcpy(c->category, fields[2], strlen(fields[2]) + 1);393        memcpy(c->input, fields[3], strlen(fields[3]) + 1);394        memcpy(c->target, fields[5], strlen(fields[5]) + 1);395        memcpy(c->family, fields[6], strlen(fields[6]) + 1);396        c->expected = (Expected) outcome;397        ++d->n;398    } {399        int ok = !ferror(f);400        if (fclose(f) != 0) ok = 0;401        return ok;402    }403}

Reject duplicate identities and leakage between splits

Section titled “Reject duplicate identities and leakage between splits”

Validation checks each row against its active schema, requires category counts, and compares IDs, families and schemas across splits. A resolved label must name an existing target. An invalid label must correspond to an invalid name or collided schema. The final benchmark cannot silently repair a wrong label by trusting fuzzy output.

Reference for the contracts used in this file

Section titled “Reference for the contracts used in this file”

C99 section 7.21.2.2 defines memmove for overlapping byte ranges. Deletion and insertion move a suffix within the same mutation buffer, including the terminator. Open reference.

404/** The same raw input in the same schema is one case, regardless of its ID. */405static int duplicate_case(const TestCase *left, const TestCase *right) {406    int same_id = !strcmp(left->id, right->id);407    int same_schema = !strcmp(left->schema, right->schema);408    int same_input = !strcmp(left->input, right->input);409    return same_id || (same_schema && same_input);410}411412/** Check one label against its active schema, not against an algorithm's score. */413static int valid_case_label(const TestCase *test, const Registry *registry, const char *normalized, int normalizable) {414    size_t property_index;415    int expects_target = test->expected == EXPECT_RESOLVED;416    int expects_invalid = test->expected == EXPECT_INVALID;417    int invalid_input_or_schema = !normalizable || registry->collision;418    if (expects_target && (!normalizable || target_index(registry, test->target) < 0)) return 0;419    if (!expects_target && * test->target) return 0;420    if (expects_invalid != invalid_input_or_schema) return 0;421    if (!invalid_input_or_schema) {422        for (property_index = 0; property_index < registry->n; ++property_index) {423            const Property *property = &registry->p[property_index];424            int exact_name = !strcmp(normalized, property->normalized);425            int wrong_label = !expects_target || strcmp(test->target, property->name);426            if (exact_name && wrong_label) return 0;427        }428    }429    return 1;430}431432/** [PM-Sp7rK9] Reject bad labels, duplicate cases and leakage before scoring.433 * Calibration and held-out counts refer to distinct rows, never timing repetitions.434 */435int validate_datasets(const Dataset *calibration, const Dataset *held_out) {436    const Dataset *sets[] = {calibration, held_out};437    const unsigned minimum[] = {20, 30, 25, 25, 25, 25, 30, 25, 20, 20, 45, 35, 30, 25};438    unsigned counts[CATEGORIES] = {0};439    size_t split, case_index, earlier, category_index_value;440    if (calibration->n < 120 || held_out->n < 380) return 0;441    for (split = 0; split < 2; ++split) {442        const Dataset *dataset = sets[split];443        for (case_index = 0; case_index < dataset->n; ++case_index) {444            const TestCase *test = &dataset->cases[case_index];445            Registry *registry = registry_get(test->schema);446            char normalized[KEY_MAX + 1];447            int normalizable = normalize(test->input, normalized, sizeof normalized);448            int category = category_index(test->category);449            int missing_identity = !test->family[0] || !test->id[0];450            if (!registry || category < 0 || missing_identity) return 0;451            if (split == 1) ++counts[category];452            if (!valid_case_label(test, registry, normalized, normalizable)) return 0;453            for (earlier = 0; earlier < case_index; ++earlier) {454                if (duplicate_case(test, &dataset->cases[earlier])) return 0;455            }456        }457    }458    for (case_index = 0; case_index < calibration->n; ++case_index) {459        for (earlier = 0; earlier < held_out->n; ++earlier) {460            const TestCase *left = &calibration->cases[case_index];461            const TestCase *right = &held_out->cases[earlier];462            int shared_family = !strcmp(left->family, right->family);463            int shared_id = !strcmp(left->id, right->id);464            int shared_schema = !strcmp(left->schema, right->schema);465            if (shared_family || shared_id || shared_schema) return 0;466        }467    }468    for (category_index_value = 0; category_index_value < CATEGORIES; ++category_index_value) {469        if (counts[category_index_value] < minimum[category_index_value]) return 0;470    }471    return 1;472}
